note: Small private RV park at 6403 S York Hwy, Clarkrange, backing onto a working cattle farm, with a coffee shop on site. Camper-reported rate: $30 a night in November 2026 (RV Life review; also $30 in September 2025); the park's own page posts no rates. --Claude
summary: Operator page is one GoDaddy page: full hook-ups, address, phone, text line - no rate, no booking, no site count. RV Life camper reports $30/night (Nov 2026, Sep 2025). Google 5.0 from only 5 reviews, three of them months-long work stays. Possible drop candidate (long-stay character + no posted price). Pin ~340 m off; Google's pin is the park.

Nightly share unknown; leans long-stay.
